closest.why: this is exactly a periodic, non-causal in-place rewrite of a bounded window of KV entries by an auxiliary module trained with the base model, matching the proposal's component (KV cache), mechanism (non-causal rewrite of a trailing window, equivalent per the task's own equivalence rule to denoising rewrite), and purpose (correcting/refining earlier KV using later context).

closest.title: Deferred Commitment Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
closest.evidence: DCD maintains a certainty-aware sliding window over masked tokens, resolving low-uncertainty tokens early while deferring high-uncertainty tokens until sufficient contextual evidence becomes available
closest.why: shares the goal of using later context to refine earlier uncertain representations within a window, though at the token/decoding level rather than explicitly the KV cache.

closest.title: Attention Is All You Need for KV Cache in Diffusion LLMs

closest.title: GatePro: Parameter-Free Expert Selection Optimization for Mixture-of-Experts Models
closest.evidence: GatePro identifies the most similar expert pairs and introduces localized competition mechanisms, preventing redundant expert co-activation while maintaining natural expert specialization.
closest.why: Same capability (pairwise-redundancy-aware expert selection at the router) but via a parameter-free competition heuristic rather than a learned 2-additive Choquet capacity/fuzzy measure with a discrete Choquet integral optimization.

closest.title: SHAPE: Coalition-Aware Expert Pruning for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
closest.evidence: SHAPE formulates routing traces on a small calibration set as an empirical cooperative game and assigns interaction-aware expert values via a Shapley-style attribution over observed top-$k$ coalitions
closest.why: Also treats expert selection as a coalitional/interaction-aware combinatorial optimization (game-theoretic capacity), close in spirit to Choquet capacities, but applied to post-hoc pruning rather than per-token joint-utility-maximizing top-k routing trained end-to-end.

survives: A genuinely novel contribution would be the specific formalism of a learned 2-additive Choquet capacity used at inference time per-token to select the joint-utility-maximizing k-subset (not aggregation, not post-hoc pruning, not a heuristic diversity penalty), trained jointly with the router from scratch and shown to beat both redundancy-heuristics (GatePro) and independent top-k scoring at matched FLOPs.

closest.title: A Hippocampus for Linear Attention: An Exact Memory for What the Recurrent State Forgets
closest.evidence: HOLA keeps the usual delta-rule state as a compressive memory and adds a bounded exact KV cache, forming a semiparametric test-time memory: the state models linearly compressible structure, while the cache stores associations that should not be forced through that state.
closest.why: Same dual-memory structure (delta-rule state + separate exact KV cache read jointly) but the delta-rule slot is the primary compressive memory and the KV cache is the exact overflow store, inverting the proposal's framing of KV-as-primary/delta-slots-as-auxiliary overwrite mechanism.

closest.title: Tensor Cache: Eviction-conditioned Associative Memory for Transformers
closest.evidence: a fixed-size outer-product fast-weight memory as a second-level cache (L2) fed by KV pairs evicted from the window... A learned scalar gate fuses the L1 and L2 outputs, and per-head decay and write-rate parameters are trained end-to-end.
closest.why: Also concatenates a positional KV window with a small delta/outer-product associative memory read jointly via attention, matching the placement and mechanism closely, though fed by evictions rather than parallel to the full cache.

closest.title: Fan Duality Model Achieves O(1) Decode Memory with Superior Associative Recall
closest.evidence: a particle component (local-global cache) that retrieves specific tokens via learned associative addressing with W+K=272 slots independent of sequence length N
closest.why: Also pairs a fixed small associative-addressed slot memory alongside a positional/local cache read jointly by attention, similar architecture-level combination.

survives: The proposal's specific twist—training the delta-memory strictly as a parallel, non-evicted auxiliary slot bank at matched param/FLOP budget purely to let later tokens overwrite stale content at matched-key positions while the full append-only KV remains untouched (rather than being fed by evictions, replacing state, or serving as the primary compressive path)—is a narrower combination not explicitly tested in HOLA, Tensor Cache, or FDM, but it is very close to all three and would likely read as a direct follow-up/ablation of this cluster.

closest.title: ReST-KV: Robust KV Cache Eviction with Layer-wise Output Reconstruction and Spatial-Temporal Smoothing

closest.why: Also uses EMA smoothing on KV cache values to reduce noise/variance, though framed within an eviction pipeline rather than as a standalone prefill-time denoising step.

closest.title: What Matters for Aggressive Decoding-Time KV Eviction? Temporal Aggregation and Ranking Preservation

survives: The only defensible twist is doing the EMA over multiple perturbed re-encodes of the same position during prefill (variance reduction via repeated forward passes) rather than EMA over sequential time-steps of a single trajectory, but this is a minor procedural variant of an already-published in-place EMA smoothing of cached K/V vectors.

closest.evidence: we propose a delayed and conditioned caching strategy for key and value states... different tokens have distinct representation dynamics throughout the diffusion process

closest.title: Prefill-Time Intervention for Mitigating Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models

closest.title: Bottlenecked Transformers: Periodic KV Cache Consolidation for Generalised Reasoning
closest.evidence: We do this through the lens of Information Bottleneck (IB) theory, which posits that model generalisation emerges from an optimal balance between input information compression and retention of predictive information in latent representations... a Cache Processor, an auxiliary Transformer that performs periodic, non-causal, in-place KV rewrites
closest.why: Applies IB theory directly to KV cache entries via a trained auxiliary module that compresses/rewrites cache to balance compression against predictive information retention, matching the proposal's component, mechanism and purpose.

closest.title: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction via a Unified Information-Theoretic Objective
closest.evidence: we derive a closed-form mutual information objective that characterizes the effective information capacity of a retained KV cache subset
closest.why: Places an information-theoretic (IB-style) objective directly on KV cache retention to control the compression/prediction tradeoff, though via eviction rather than a learned encoder.

closest.title: Recurrent Preference Memory for Efficient Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
closest.evidence: Analysis reveals that the Preference Memory functions as a denoising Information Bottleneck, effectively filtering interaction noise to capture robust long-term interests.
closest.why: Uses a trained bottleneck to compress cache-like memory into minimal sufficient statistics for downstream prediction, same mechanism/purpose in a different domain.

survives: Only a genuinely per-entry, target-driven variable-rate allocation measured explicitly in nats via a VIB reparameterized-Gaussian encoder (rather than eviction/rewriting at fixed or heuristic budgets) could still be new, but 2505.16950 already frames KV rewriting explicitly as IB-driven compression-vs-prediction tradeoff at the same component for the same purpose.

closest.title: Don't Waste Bits! Adaptive KV-Cache Quantization for Lightweight On-Device LLMs
closest.evidence: a learned policy that assigns bit-width proportional to token importance, minimizing expected memory and latency ... dynamically selects KV precision from {2-bit, 4-bit, 8-bit, FP16} during decoding
closest.why: same component (KV cache) and same capability (per-entry adaptive precision allocation to minimize size), but driven by a learned importance controller rather than an explicit MDL two-part code length objective.

closest.title: The risk of KV cache compression
closest.evidence: characterizing the minimax risk of KV cache compression in terms of the intrinsic compressibility of a cache ... yield novel design principles for KV cache compression under causal masking that map efficiently to prefill and autoregressive decoding while achieving minimax-optimal risk
closest.why: closest in spirit to a principled information-theoretic objective for compression allocation, though framed as minimax risk rather than per-entry MDL code-length accounting.

closest.title: EvolKV: Evolutionary KV Cache Compression for LLM Inference
closest.evidence: reformulating cache allocation as a multi-objective optimization problem, EvolKV leverages evolutionary search to dynamically configure layer budgets while directly maximizing downstream performance
closest.why: same goal of principled (non-heuristic) budget allocation across cache entries but via evolutionary search on task performance, not MDL bit-cost minimization.

survives: A genuinely new twist would be the explicit online two-part MDL code-length computation (model bits for quantization level choice + residual bits under a fitted prior) reported and minimized per-entry as a measurable quantity, rather than a learned/heuristic/task-performance-driven importance score—none of the found papers compute or optimize this explicit code-length decomposition.
